subtitle: ASSOCIATE EXAM PREP · A06 · SECTION 2 (21%) · LAKEFLOW CONNECT, JDBC AND REST QUICK REFERENCE

pages.title: A06 · Lakeflow Connect, JDBC and REST
lede: Objectives (S2): configure Lakeflow Connect; use Java Database Connectivity (JDBC), Open Database Connectivity (ODBC) or REST clients in notebooks; prioritize between Auto Loader, Lakeflow Connect, partner connectors and other methods.
Free Edition: the REST pattern runs with a simulated API. Database change data capture (CDC) connectors and external JDBC reads need a paid workspace and a reachable database.

blocks.heading: 1. The ingestion menu: start with the most managed layer
blocks.code:
Managed connectors   software as a service (SaaS) apps (Salesforce, Workday) + databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle)
Standard connectors  Auto Loader, COPY INTO, Structured Streaming (Kafka): you write the code
Partner connectors   third-party tools, many via Partner Connect
DIY in a notebook    JDBC, ODBC or REST clients
No copy needed       Lakehouse Federation (query the source in place)
blocks.note: Databricks recommends the most managed layer that supports your source; drop down only when it doesn't.

blocks.heading: 2. Lakeflow Connect database connector (CDC): five parts
blocks.code:
connection          Unity Catalog securable: host + credentials (CREATE / USE CONNECTION)
ingestion gateway   classic compute, runs CONTINUOUSLY, reads change logs before truncation
staging volume      Unity Catalog volume; staged data purged after 30 days
ingestion pipeline  serverless, triggered on a schedule by a job (not continuous)
destination         streaming tables (Delta); first run = snapshot, then changes incl. deletes
blocks.note: SaaS connectors: connection + pipeline + tables, no gateway or staging. SQL Server needs change tracking or CDC enabled.

blocks.heading: 3. JDBC in a notebook
blocks.code:
df = (spark.read.format("jdbc").option("url", jdbc_url).option("dbtable", "public.customers")
      .option("user", dbutils.secrets.get("crm", "user"))
      .option("password", dbutils.secrets.get("crm", "password")).load())   # then saveAsTable
# parallel: partitionColumn + lowerBound + upperBound + numPartitions   fetchSize = rows per trip
# governed: .option("databricks.connection", "crm_jdbc").option("query", "SELECT ...")
blocks.note: Default = one query on one thread. query runs in the source's SQL dialect, not with partitionColumn. ODBC (pyodbc) needs a driver you install.

pages.title: REST pattern, decision table, exam traps

blocks.heading: 4. Configure it: UI or bundle
blocks.code:
UI: Data Ingestion > SQL Server > connection > pipeline, gateway, staging > tables > destination > Validate > schedule
YAML: gateway_definition (connection_name, gateway_storage_*), continuous; ingestion_definition (ingestion_gateway_id, objects)

blocks.heading: 5. REST client in a notebook (runs in Free Edition with a simulated API)
blocks.code:
while page:                                   # follow the pages until next_page is None
    body = get_page(page)                     # real: requests.get(url, params, headers, timeout).json()
    dbutils.fs.put(f"{raw}/run_{run_id}/p{page}.json", "\n".join(json.dumps(r) for r in body["data"]))
    page = body["next_page"]                  # then Auto Loader availableNow -> 5 rows
blocks.note: Raw in a volume = audit + replay. Direct createDataFrame + append is simpler, but a rerun duplicates rows.

blocks.heading: 6. Scenario words to method
blocks.code:
files keep arriving in cloud storage, any volume   -> Auto Loader
few files, SQL, idempotent reload                  -> COPY INTO
supported SaaS app or database, least maintenance  -> Lakeflow Connect managed connector
need database inserts, updates AND deletes         -> managed database connector (CDC)
custom query / database without a connector        -> JDBC (or query-based connector)
HTTP API without a connector                       -> REST client + Lakeflow Jobs schedule
team already runs a partner tool                   -> partner connector
query in place, no copy                            -> Lakehouse Federation
blocks.note: Decide on data volume, ingestion frequency, data types and Unity Catalog governance.

blocks.heading: 7. Five exam traps
blocks.text: 1) Most managed layer that supports the source first. 2) CDC gateway: continuous, classic compute; ingestion pipeline: scheduled, serverless. 3) JDBC = one single-threaded query unless partitionColumn + bounds + numPartitions. 4) Credentials in secrets or a connection, never the URL. 5) Auto Loader reads files, not databases or APIs.

blocks.heading: Practice challenge
blocks.text: Q1 clickstream JSON files in S3 -> Auto Loader. Q2 Salesforce daily, minimal maintenance -> managed SaaS connector. Q3 internal HTTP API, hourly -> REST notebook, land raw, Auto Loader, Lakeflow Jobs.
